xBRIEFInfo.description: Deterministic copy-edit checkers and optional apply

narratives.Overview: First engine in the pipeline: deterministic checkers for grammar/mechanics where rules are reliable, style consistency hooks, and light wordiness/echo heuristics safe enough for code. Optional --apply writes only safe deterministic fixes. Traces: FR-DET-1, FR-APPLY-1.
narratives.Acceptance: Checkers emit Finding records with engine=deterministic. --apply changes only whitelisted safe fixes and is off by default. Fiction dialogue edge cases have tests documenting known limits.

narrative.Overview: Implement first-pass grammar/mechanics and style rules; light wordiness/echo heuristics that stay conservative.
Apply only deterministic safe fixes; leave TypeSafe/LLM suggestions report-only.
